manual.note: Honda 2015 CR-V Owner's Manual (PDF, 533 pp; footer 15 CR-V-31T0A6300). Oil and tires p.511, viscosity p.442, towing p.353, TPMS p.401-402. No battery capacity is printed. Printed page = PDF page - 2.

oilCapacity.value: 2.4L 4-cylinder (K24W): 4.6 US qt (4.4 L) with filter, 4.4 US qt (4.2 L) without
oilCapacity.appliesTo: 2.4L 4-cylinder (K24W) only in this market; 2WD and AWD share the same fill.

oilViscosity.value: Genuine Honda Motor Oil 0W-20 or API Premium-grade 0W-20 detergent oil

batteryGroup.note: this edition prints no battery reserve-capacity or BCI group number

tpmsReset.value: Press and hold the TPMS button until the low tire pressure/TPMS indicator blinks a few times; the calibration then finishes automatically after about 30 minutes of cumulative driving at 30-60 mph. Models with the multi-information display can instead select TPMS CALIBRATION > Calibrate.

tires.note: Compact spare: T165/80D17 104M at 60 psi. Pressures are cold inflation pressures printed in the Specifications table.
